announced on Tuesday that it will offer up to 200M shares of Class A shares via a rights offering.
The shareholders of record on October 2, 2026, will receive one transferable right for each Class A share owned.
The subscription price will be the higher of $2.00 or 85% of UWMC’s 10-day VWAP from October 27 to November 9.
Investors who fully exercise their basic rights can also buy additional unsubscribed shares.
The rights are expected to begin regular-way trading on the NYSE on October 6 under UWMC RT, with the offering scheduled to expire November 12, unless extended.
Oaktree Capital Management and the Ishbia Support Parties have agreed to backstop the offering to ensure at least $400M in gross proceeds if shareholder subscriptions fall short.
The backstop can be funded through Class A common stock or a combination of preferred stock and warrants.
The company is targeting at least $400M in gross proceeds, with existing shareholders getting the first opportunity to participate.
Following the news, the UWM's stock traded ~3.17 lower at ~$1.22 in the pre-market session.

title: UWM Holdings sets 200M-share rights offering, targets $400M raise
